title: ServerEvent (SPEC.md §6.3)
description: One message from the agent to the app frontend, in the JSON encoding of the envelope (SPEC.md §6, §6.3). Each message is a JSON object whose `type` names the variant in snake_case; the variant's fields sit beside `type`, including the fields of the proposal message. The envelope evolves additively within a major version (SPEC.md §13): receivers ignore fields they do not know, so no message here sets `additionalProperties: false`. Kept in step with `ServerEvent` in crates/cleverhans-core/src/envelope.rs by crates/cleverhans-core/tests/spec_schemas.rs.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Assistant prose. One text segment MAY arrive as any number of `done: false` fragments followed by exactly one `done: true` message with the authoritative full text, all sharing one `msg_id` (SPEC.md §6.3, streaming contract).

msg_id.description: Agent-generated message ID; clients key fragment accumulation by it.

text.description: Message content: an incremental fragment when `done` is false, the authoritative full text of the segment when `done` is true.

done.description: Marks turn completion. A non-streaming sender emits a single `done: true` message per segment.

ActionProposal.title: ActionProposal
ActionProposal.description: A validated proposal, ready to render (SPEC.md §6.4). Immutable once emitted; a changed intent is a new proposal. On the wire the proposal fields sit beside `type`.

action_id.description: A registered action ID (SPEC.md §3). The envelope never enumerates actions.

params.description: Fully filled params: context-sourced + validated utterance-sourced.

block_type.description: A registered block type (normally the action's).

slots.description: Typed slot values for that block (SPEC.md §8).

preview.description: Permission-correct dry-run preview. REQUIRED for mutating actions (SPEC.md §6.4); null or absent otherwise.

context_seq.description: The context snapshot this proposal was built against (unsigned 64-bit).

turn_msg_id.description: Correlates to the chat turn that produced it. Absent and null both mean no correlation.

state.description: New state: a SPEC.md §7 state name. The states a frontend observes are `validated`, `confirmed`, `executed` (with `result`), `rejected`, `expired` and `failed`; `proposed` and `invalid` exist only agent-side. A plain string, not an enum, on purpose (SPEC.md §11): a frontend MUST treat an unrecognized state as terminal and act on it no further.

reason.description: Optional explanation (expiry cause, handler error, …). Absent and null both mean no reason.

result.description: Handler result for `executed`: any JSON value. Absent and null both mean no result.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: Stream- or turn-level errors that are not proposal state changes.

recoverable.description: Whether the session can continue. After an error with `recoverable: false` the session is over: the agent processes no further client message and the binding closes the stream (SPEC.md §6.3).

DryRunPreview.title: DryRunPreview
DryRunPreview.description: Permission-correct preview of what a mutating action would do (SPEC.md §6.4), computed side-effect-free under the principal's own data-access rules. Every field has a default, so `{}` is a valid empty preview.

affected_count.description: How many records the action would touch (unsigned 64-bit). Absent means 0.

sample_ids.description: A bounded sample of affected record identifiers. Absent means an empty list.

summary.description: Optional human-readable one-liner. Absent and null both mean no summary.

extensions.description: App-defined preview payload (e.g. a diff). Absent means an empty map.
